name: json_serializable
summary: A Dart build-system generator that creates typed toJson and fromJson code from annotated model classes.
advantages: Keeps JSON field mapping explicit through annotations
Works with typed Dart models and common code-generation stacks
tradeoffs: Schema or API changes still require model maintenance and regeneration
recommendedFor: Applications that exchange substantial JSON data
Projects that want generated serialization instead of handwritten map conversion

verification.reason: Current pub.dev metadata and package documentation are sufficient.
